title: We made a psychological puzzle game with AI agents — here’s our new trailer
author: TheAuthorBTLG_
selftext:
"We" are BrainLiftGames, and this is the new trailer for The Red Button Problem, "our" psychological puzzle game.

Okay, seriously, I was mainly developing a proper real game, but it was starting to annoy me to test the same room/level again and again. So I did something in between. Started this as a joke, but after two days I liked it so much that I spent the last four weeks polishing it. And now it's done. Steam just has to approve it. It's also on itch.

The development process was basically me playing the game and saying, "Hey, wouldn't it be nice if...?" and then I threw a bit of Opus 5.5 at it, tested, improved, tested again, looped until I was satisfied enough to publish it. Everything is agent-crafted, so no item has been done in Blender or by an image model; it's all coded.

I wanted to make it a short ten minutes game, but now it has... let me count... 119 rooms. The demo is free. You can find it here: 

[https://theauthorbtlg.itch.io/red-button](https://theauthorbtlg.itch.io/red-button) and [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5517440/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5517440/)

I will polish the game a bit more and release it in the next few days. If you want to provide ideas, I can probably find some space to integrate them.
